objective:
Research request: growth plan for Swarm Pepes.

CONTEXT
Swarm Pepes is a fully onchain pixel-art Pepe NFT collection on Ethereum mainnet (contract 0x999ce0ce8c5f7661e0c74a568ffe27ceb9177bdb). Max supply 5000, max 3 per wallet. Mint is free: allowlisted wallets mint by sending a 0 ETH transaction to the contract. The owner grants allowlist slots with grant(address[], uint256). Art is revealed onchain via a 27-hour reveal window; tokens that miss it stay "ghosts" forever. Rare traits: Gold skin (1%), Crown hat (3%). Royalties are 10% but not enforced. Website: swarmpepe.xyz. The collection is closely tied to the IMD swarm community: the allowlist so far went to IMD seat holders and wallets that paid for swarm jobs.

QUESTIONS (answer each by number)
1. Top 5 ideas to grow the collection: holder utility, onchain mechanics, partnerships, events. For each: what it is, effort, expected impact.
2. Top 5 groups of wallets to add to the allowlist next. For each: why they fit, how to find them onchain (which contracts or events to read), rough wallet count, and any sybil/bot risk.
3. Top 5 short video ideas (15-30s, vertical) in our existing style: retro 8-bit pixel art, dark background, neon green CRT glow, scanlines, chiptune. For each: one-line hook, beat-by-beat outline, ending text.

DELIVERABLE
A concise report with numbered answers 1-3, ranked best first within each list. Research only, no deployment.
